Container.Name: OptiKeep
Container.Overview: OptiKeep read-only development preview. SQLite3 or PostgreSQL. Install an analysis worker separately. No quarantine or deletion in this preview.
Container.Description: Read-only OptiKeep development preview for Linux amd64.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Coordinator HTTP port; trusted LAN only.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Pre-create writable by UID 99:GID 100. Stores SQLite and coordinator lock.

Config.Name: Administrator token
Config.Description: Separate random token; at least 24 characters.

Config.Name: Daemon token
Config.Description: Same token on coordinator and workers; at least 24 characters.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Select the same media directory for coordinator and workers; read-only.
